Check My Eligibility FAQsWhat is a secured credit card?A secured credit card requires a refundable deposit, which is held as collateral for the account. It’s a credit card that offers you an opportunity to build or rebuild your credit with responsible use.
No interest is applied to the deposit.How does the Discover it Secured Cash Back Credit Card work?Once you’re approved, all it takes to get started is a minimum required deposit, which you can pay all at once or over time within 35 days of being approved. You can make your deposit online. When you’ve made your minimum required deposit and activated your card, your account will be opened.
There are two ways your deposit can be refunded. First, with a positive track record, you can earn back your deposit as a statement credit
or second, we will refund it when you close your account and pay your balance in full.
Your card status will be regularly reported to the three major credit bureaus.How is the Discover it Secured Cash Back Credit Card different from a prepaid card?Unlike a prepaid card, a secured card is an actual credit card that is reported to the three major credit bureaus—providing the opportunity to build your credit, with responsible use.
Prepaid cards are more like debit cards and cannot help you build your credit because they are not reported to the major credit bureaus.Will my Discover it Secured Cash Back Credit Card have the word “secured” on it?No. Your Discover it Secured Cash Back Credit Card will not have the word “secured” on it. It will look just like other Discover credit cards.Can I be declined for the Discover it Secured Cash Back Credit Card?Yes. As with any credit card, there are certain conditions that could cause your application for this credit card to be declined.What happens to my deposit?Your deposit is held as collateral against your credit line. There are two ways your deposit can be refunded. First, with a positive track record, you can earn back your deposit as a statement credit
or second, we will refund it when you close your account and pay your balance in full.How can I pay the deposit for my Discover it Secured Cash Back Credit Card?If you are approved for a Discover it Secured Cash Back Credit Card, you’ll be required to pay a refundable deposit online. All deposits must be at least $20 and in whole dollar increments and funded through an electronic funds transfer from a bank account — cash, checks, and other money transfer methods are not accepted. You can make your required deposit via the link sent to your email or in your approval letter.Can I pay my deposit over time?Yes. You can make partial payments but need to make sure you’ve made your full, required deposit within 35 days of being approved. Once we’ve received your required deposit, your card will be on its way. All deposits must be at least $20 and in whole dollar increments.What happens if I don’t send in the required deposit for my Discover it Secured Cash Back Credit Card?You must make your required deposit payment within 35 days of being approved. If you do not make your required deposit, we will not be able to open an account for you.Does my deposit cover the monthly payments for charges I make to my Discover it Secured Cash Back Credit Card?No, you must still make at least your minimum monthly payment each month. Paying your credit card balance in full each month instead of carrying a balance is a good idea.Can I make an additional deposit and increase my initial credit line?Yes. If your application is approved and you provide the minimum required deposit prior to the expiration date, your account will be opened, and you will receive the minimum initial credit line. To increase your initial credit line, simply deposit more than your minimum required deposit within 35 days of being approved and before you activate your card. You can raise your initial credit line up to your maximum limit. Your maximum limit will be assigned upon approval and range from $1,000 to $3,000 based on your creditworthiness.How do I increase my credit line without having to make an additional deposit?You may earn credit line increases based on your payment history and creditworthiness with no additional deposit needed.What gets reported to the credit bureaus?We report your credit standing to the three major credit bureaus. Credit standing includes information like whether you make your minimum payment in full and on time every month. A history of good credit standing can help build your credit with responsible use.
However, not making your minimum payments on time each month can damage your credit. See More FAQs Refundable DepositAs low as $49 for a minimum $200 credit line.
When you establish a positive track record, you’ll earn your deposit back and upgrade to the Discover it Cash Back Credit Card.
How to build credit with a secured credit cardWhen you are looking to build or rebuild credit with responsible use,
a secured card can help prepare you for the future when you know how to manage it. Understand your account terms Keep your balances low Pay credit bills on time Students may qualify for traditional credit cards If you’re interested in a secured credit card, make sure you understand the credit card issuer terms. Are there additional fees beyond the deposit? Is the deposit refundable? Will they upgrade you to an unsecured credit card if you’re eligible?
